You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
AGENT: Hi Kevin, I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me look up the stores first and then pull up your prescriptions. I found the Gahanna store. Before I pull up your prescriptions, I need to verify your identity—can you give me your date of birth?  [system actions: find_stores, find_stores]
CALLER: August 30th, 1982. So once you verify that, can we get all three of us switched over today?
AGENT: Great, you're verified. Now I need to know the names and dates of birth for the other two family members so I can pull up all the prescriptions and move them over.  [system actions: verify_identity]
CALLER: Sure, Maya Brooks, born June 20th, 2017. And Eli Brooks, born February 11th, 2010. Can we get all of us switched today?
AGENT: Perfect, I've got everyone verified. You have three prescriptions total: your lisinopril, Maya's albuterol inhaler, and Eli's Vyvanse. I can set Gahanna as your home pharmacy for all three of you right away. For your lisinopril and Maya's albuterol, I can transfer those today since they have refills. Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled, so that one needs a new prescription from his doctor—I can request that for the Gahanna store. Let me get started.  [system actions: verify_identity, verify_identity, list_prescriptions, list_prescriptions, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Wait, why not the Vyvanse? Okay, so what's the plan for Eli?
AGENT: Good question. Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled, so it can't be transferred or refilled—that's a federal rule. To get him set up at Gahanna, his doctor needs to write a new prescription. I can request that from Dr. Okafor and send it to the Gahanna store. Once she approves it, he'll be all set there. Does that work?
CALLER: Okay, that works. So go ahead and request that from Dr. Okafor for Gahanna, and my lisinopril and Maya's inhaler transfer today?
AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Alright, sounds good. So once you send that request, how long before Eli's new script actually shows up at Gahanna?
AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Hello? You still there? Just need a rough timeframe on Eli's script.
AGENT: Sorry about that! I don't have visibility into how long Dr. Okafor will take to respond—that depends on her office. Once she approves it, it should show up at Gahanna pretty quickly, but I'd recommend calling the Gahanna store in a day or two to check on it, or having Eli's doctor's office send it directly if they can. Does that help?
CALLER: Okay, that works. So just to recap - lisinopril and the inhaler transfer today, Vyvanse request goes to Dr. Okafor, and I'll check back with Gahanna in a couple days. Thanks for the help.
AGENT (LATEST): You're all set. Let me get those transfers and the new Vyvanse request going now.

CONDITIONS:
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "The prescriptions are Kevin's lisinopril, Maya's albuterol inhaler, Eli's Vyvanse"
stop_0: Agent recaps: two moved, defaults set, Vyvanse new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent's latest turn asks nothing; just confirms action."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No detailed recap given, just brief confirmation."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
